ck_assignment_status_fields.name: ck_assignment_status_fields
ck_assignment_status_fields.value: ((status = 'ACTIVE'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'RETURNED'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::assignment_status) AND (returned_at IS NULL))

ck_incident_status_fields.name: ck_incident_status_fields
ck_incident_status_fields.value: ((status = 'RESOLVED'::incident_status) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'RESOLVED'::incident_status) AND (resolved_at IS NULL))

ck_asset_transfer_request_review_fields.name: ck_asset_transfer_request_review_fields
ck_asset_transfer_request_review_fields.value: ((status IN ('CONFIRMED'::document_status, 'REJECTED'::document_status)) AND reviewed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('CONFIRMED'::document_status, 'REJECTED'::document_status) AND reviewed_by_member_id IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)

ck_asset_next_maintenance_date.name: ck_asset_next_maintenance_date
ck_asset_next_maintenance_date.value: (last_maintenance_date IS NULL) OR (next_maintenance_date IS NULL) OR (next_maintenance_date >= last_maintenance_date)

ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture.name: ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture
ck_lot_expiry_after_manufacture.value: (manufactured_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date IS NULL) OR (expiry_date >= manufactured_date)

ck_item_type_tracking_mode.name: ck_item_type_tracking_mode
ck_item_type_tracking_mode.value: ((item_type = 'MATERIAL'::item_type) AND (tracking_mode IN ('QUANTITY'::tracking_mode, 'LOT'::tracking_mode))) OR ((item_type IN ('EQUIPMENT'::item_type, 'TOOL'::item_type)) AND (tracking_mode IN ('QUANTITY'::tracking_mode, 'ASSET'::tracking_mode)))

ck_maintenance_time_order.name: ck_maintenance_time_order
ck_maintenance_time_order.value: ((started_at IS NULL) OR (scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (started_at >= scheduled_at)) AND ((completed_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (completed_at >= started_at))

ck_maintenance_status_fields.name: ck_maintenance_status_fields
ck_maintenance_status_fields.value: ((status = 'SCHEDULED'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'COMPLETED'::maintenance_status) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::maintenance_status) AND (completed_at IS NULL))

ck_maintenance_request_review_fields.name: ck_maintenance_request_review_fields
ck_maintenance_request_review_fields.value: ((status IN ('CONFIRMED'::document_status, 'REJECTED'::document_status)) AND reviewed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('CONFIRMED'::document_status, 'REJECTED'::document_status) AND reviewed_by_member_id IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)

ck_notification_push_outbox_lock_pair.name: ck_notification_push_outbox_lock_pair
ck_notification_push_outbox_lock_pair.value: ("notification_push_outbox"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "notification_push_outbox"."lock_id" IS NULL) OR ("notification_push_outbox"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_push_outbox"."lock_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_notification_push_outbox_receipt_tick.name: ck_notification_push_outbox_receipt_ticket
ck_notification_push_outbox_receipt_tick.value: "notification_push_outbox"."status" NOT IN ('AWAITING_RECEIPT', 'SUCCEEDED') OR ("notification_push_outbox"."expo_ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("notification_push_outbox"."expo_ticket_id")) > 0)

ck_count_requested_code.name: ck_count_requested_code
ck_count_requested_code.value: (requested_code IS NULL) OR ((btrim(requested_code) <> '') AND (coalesce(btrim(requested_code_reason), '') <> '') AND (requested_by_member_id IS NOT NULL))

ck_count_confirm_fields.name: ck_count_confirm_fields
ck_count_confirm_fields.value: (status <> 'CONFIRMED'::stock_count_status) OR ((confirmed_by_member_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))

ck_issue_maintenance_reference.name: ck_issue_maintenance_reference

ck_issue_confirm_fields.name: ck_issue_confirm_fields

ck_transfer_confirm_fields.name: ck_transfer_confirm_fields

ck_store_orders_payment.name: ck_store_orders_payment
ck_store_orders_payment.value: ("store_orders"."payment_status" = 'UNPAID' AND "store_orders"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "store_orders"."paid_by_member_id" IS NULL) OR ("store_orders"."payment_status" = 'PAID' AND "store_orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "store_orders"."paid_by_member_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_store_orders_status_fields.name: ck_store_orders_status_fields
ck_store_orders_status_fields.value:
("store_orders"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR "store_orders"."stock_issue_id" IS NULL)
    AND ("store_orders"."status" NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'SHIPPING', 'COMPLETED') OR ("store_orders"."stock_issue_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_orders"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL))
    AND ("store_orders"."status" NOT IN ('SHIPPING', 'COMPLETED') OR "store_orders"."shipped_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("store_orders"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' OR ("store_orders"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "store_orders"."payment_status" = 'PAID'))
    AND ("store_orders"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' OR ("store_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "store_orders"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("store_orders"."cancel_reason")) > 0 AND "store_orders"."payment_status" = 'UNPAID'))
